title: Delhi High Court refuses interim relief to Sonam Wangchuk, says hospitalisation not arbitrary
description: The Delhi High Court on Sunday refused to pass an interim order directing the discharge of activist Sonam Wangchuk from Safdarjung Hospital [Gitanjali J Angmo v. Union of India & Ors].Wangchuk, who was on a hunger strike against the government, was forcibly taken to the hospital by the Delhi Police from Jantar Mantar, the site of his protest.
